## History

In Anne's childhood imagination, Violetta was a little girl who lived in an echo in a valley near Mrs. Hammond's house. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) considered Violetta to be a great friend and loved her almost as much as she loved her imaginary friend [Katie Maurice](../character/katie-maurice.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--violetta.md)

Violetta is an imaginary echo girl whom [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) created as a friend. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) treats her as a companion to talk to and confide in through her imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)_
